2010-12-06.headline: Revenue slipped on last week and fewer orders came in, but bigger baskets held up
2010-12-06.text:
Product revenue came to £301 064 from 526 orders, down -5.1% on last week and down -9.3% against the recent four-week picture. Compared with the same week a year ago, revenue was up +15.5%. Orders fell -19.3% on last week, but the average order value was £572.36, up +17.7%, which cushioned the drop. We sold 121 081 units to 406 customers, of whom 23 were new and 383 were returning.

The best sellers were "REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER" with £10 903, "VINTAGE UNION JACK MEMOBOARD" with £6 562 and "WOOD BLACK BOARD ANT WHITE FINISH" with £5 716. By country, "United Kingdom" brought in £276 494, followed by "Japan" at £7 385 and "France" at £4 050.

The cancellation rate was 16.9%, with cancelled product value of £5 012, leaving revenue after product cancellations at £296 051. Nothing was listed as unusual this week.

2010-12-13.headline: Sales fell sharply this week, with unusually big drops in revenue and orders
2010-12-13.text:
Product revenue came in at £208 614 from 442 orders, with an average order value of £471.98. Revenue fell against last week, at -30.7%, and against the recent four-week level, at -33.8%. Both moves are unusual. Orders were also unusually weak against the four-week level, at -29.0%, and were down week on week at -16.0%. Compared with the same week a year ago, revenue was down, at -10.8%.

Customers numbered 335, of whom 16 were new, and the customer count was down week on week at -17.5%. The top product was "REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER" at £5 745, followed by "WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER" at £4 217. The "United Kingdom" brought in £192 772, well ahead of "Germany" at £4 525.

The cancellation rate was 21.9%, and cancelled product value was £6 433. That leaves revenue after product cancellations at £202 181.

2010-12-20.headline: Revenue and orders fell sharply this week, with unusually big drops against recent weeks
2010-12-20.text:
Product revenue reached £85 158 from 158 orders. Both moves were unusual. Revenue fell -59.2% on the previous week and fell -69.7% against the recent four-week average. Orders fell -64.3% on the previous week and fell -72.5% against the four-week average.

Fewer, larger orders made up the week: average order value was £538.98, up +14.2% on last week, from 86 customers. The best seller was "REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER" at £3 330, followed by "WHITE SKULL HOT WATER BOTTLE" at £2 211. "United Kingdom" brought in £70 128 and "Netherlands" added £8 577.

The cancellation rate was 24.8%. Cancelled product value came to £2 579, which leaves revenue after cancellations at £82 579.

2011-01-03.headline: Revenue fell against recent weeks and last year, with more than one in six orders cancelled
2011-01-03.text:
Product revenue reached £130 275 from 242 orders, with an average order value of £538.33. Revenue fell, with a change of -12.4% against the recent four-week average and -21.5% against the same week last year. Cancelled product value was £4 764, which leaves £125 511 after cancellations, and the cancellation rate was 19.3%.

Orders were down -14.0% on the four-week average but up +21.0% on last year. Average order value increased +1.9% on the recent average but fell -35.1% on last year. Units sold were 76 739, up +14.9% on the recent average and down -20.1% on last year. Customers numbered 207, with 14 new and 193 returning, up +0.1% on the recent average and up +24.7% on last year.

The best sellers were "CHILLI LIGHTS" at £3 882, "REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER" at £3 033 and "WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER" at £2 581. By country, "United Kingdom" led with £113 862, followed by "Australia" at £7 154 and "Germany" at £3 652.

2011-01-10.headline: Unusually strong week for revenue, driven mostly by bigger orders
2011-01-10.text:
Product revenue reached £187 291 from 258 orders, with an average order value of £725.94. Revenue was up +43.8% on the previous week and up +76.7% against the recent four-week picture. Both moves are unusual, so treat them as a standout week rather than the new normal.

Order numbers rose more gently, up +6.6% on last week, while average order value increased +34.9%. We sold 89 207 units to 212 customers, of whom 16 were new and 196 were returning. Compared with the same week last year, revenue was up +20.5% but orders were down -1.5%.

The top product was "WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER" at £9 263, followed by "FAIRY CAKE FLANNEL ASSORTED COLOUR" at £6 608. "United Kingdom" brought in £143 014 and "EIRE" added £16 775. The cancellation rate was 18.4%, with cancelled product value of £2 344, so it is worth keeping an eye on.

2011-01-17.headline: Large cancellations this week: £78 841 of product value was cancelled, so read revenue with care
2011-01-17.text:
Product revenue was £209 331 from 229 orders, but cancelled product value reached £78 841. That leaves £130 491 after product cancellations, and the cancellation rate was 19.4%. Revenue rose +11.8% on the previous week, but with this much cancelled it should not be read as good news.

Two moves against the recent average are unusual. Revenue was up +107.9% against the four-week average, and orders were up +39.2% against the same period. Against last week, orders fell -11.2%.

One product stands out: "MEDIUM CERAMIC TOP STORAGE JAR" brought in £77 184, far ahead of anything else. By country, "United Kingdom" led with £177 008, followed by "Netherlands" with £16 088. It is worth checking whether the cancellations are linked to that one big-selling product.

2011-01-24.headline: Revenue fell sharply this week even though orders climbed
2011-01-24.text:
Product revenue came in at £120 986 from 290 orders. Revenue fell, at -42.2% against last week, and that is an unusual move. It was also down at -8.2% against the four-week average and down at -16.5% on the same week last year.

Orders rose, at +26.6% on last week and +59.1% on the four-week average, and both of those moves are unusual. More orders but less revenue means smaller baskets: average order value was £417.19, which fell at -54.4% week on week. We had 243 customers, of whom 25 were new.

The cancellation rate was 18.5%, with £4 301 of product value cancelled, leaving £116 685 after cancellations. The "United Kingdom" brought in £95 156, followed by "Germany" at £6 209 and "Sweden" at £2 939. "WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER" was among the best sellers at £1 503.

2011-01-31.headline: Revenue steady on last week but unusually far below the four-week level
2011-01-31.text:
Product revenue reached £121 349 from 295 orders. Revenue was up +0.3% on the previous week and up +1.1% on the same week last year. Against the previous four weeks it was down -25.1%, which is an unusual move and worth a closer look.

Orders increased +1.7% on last week and were up +15.8% on the four-week level, so the shortfall comes from smaller baskets. Average order value was £411.35, down -35.3% against the four-week level. Units sold were 69 283. We served 245 customers, of whom 35 were new and 210 were returning.

The top product was "BLACK RECORD COVER FRAME" at £2 013, followed by "REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER" at £1 891. "United Kingdom" brought in £106 606, with "France" next at £5 711. The cancellation rate was 15.7%, and revenue after product cancellations was £119 040.

2011-02-07.headline: Revenue down on last week and unusually far below the recent four-week level
2011-02-07.text:
Product revenue was £103 557 from 222 orders. Revenue fell against the previous week, with the change at -14.7%. Against the recent four-week level it fell by -35.2%, which is an unusual move and worth a closer look. Compared with the same week a year ago, revenue rose, up +19.2%. Orders decreased by -24.7% on last week, while average order value was £466.47, up +13.4%.

We served 183 customers, of whom 19 were new and 164 were returning. The top product was "VINTAGE UNION JACK MEMOBOARD" at £6 501, followed by "CREAM HEART CARD HOLDER" at £2 404 and "GROW A FLYTRAP OR SUNFLOWER IN TIN" at £2 320. By country, "United Kingdom" brought in £89 572, then "Japan" with £5 735 and "Germany" with £2 841.

The cancellation rate was 28.2%, with cancelled product value of £3 304. Revenue after product cancellations came to £100 254.

2011-02-14.headline: Unusually big jump in weekly revenue and orders, but still behind last year
2011-02-14.text:
Product revenue reached £140 305 from 294 orders, with an average order value of £477.23. Revenue was up +35.5% on the week before and orders increased +32.4%. Both moves are unusual, so treat them with some care.

Compared with the recent four-week picture, revenue was up +1.1%, so the jump mostly brings us back to normal. Against the same week last year, revenue was down -17.8% and units sold were down -54.0%. We had 236 customers, of whom 29 were new. The cancellation rate was 15.0%.

Top sellers included "JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT" at £1 733 and "CHILLI LIGHTS" at £1 588. By country, "United Kingdom" brought in £107 594, followed by "Australia" at £14 023 and "EIRE" at £7 767.

2011-02-21.headline: Sales up on last week and well ahead of the recent average, though still behind this time last year
2011-02-21.text:
Product revenue reached £145 234 from 289 orders, with an average order value of £502.54. Revenue rose +3.5% on last week and was up +19.5% on the four-week average, but it was down -9.4% on the same week last year. Orders were down -1.7% on last week and up +5.0% on the four-week average. We sold 84 371 units to 245 customers, of whom 33 were new and 212 were returning.

Our top product was "EMPIRE DESIGN ROSETTE" at £3 278, followed by "REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER" at £2 529 and "ASSORTED COLOUR MINI CASES" at £1 551. By country, "United Kingdom" led with £113 615, then "Netherlands" with £21 491 and "Germany" with £2 729.

The cancellation rate was 14.0%, with cancelled product value of £3 244. That leaves revenue after product cancellations at £141 990.

2011-02-28.headline: Revenue slipped on last week, with order numbers close to steady
2011-02-28.text:
Product revenue reached £127 588 from 283 orders, with an average order value of £450.84. Revenue was down -12.1% on the previous week and flat (+0.0%) against the four-week average. Compared with the same week last year it fell -21.2%.

Orders were down -2.1% on last week, so the drop in revenue came mostly from smaller baskets: average order value fell -10.3%. Units sold came to 69 204, down -18.0%. We had 242 customers, of whom 41 were new and 201 were returning. Nothing was unusual enough to call out this week.

The "United Kingdom" brought in £93 841, followed by "Australia" at £16 727. Among products, "VINTAGE UNION JACK BUNTING" made £2 289 and "PARTY BUNTING" made £1 223. The cancellation rate was 16.8%, with cancelled product value of £1 370, leaving £126 218 after cancellations.

2011-03-07.headline: Revenue edges up on the week, but fewer customers bought and the year-on-year picture is softer
2011-03-07.text:
Product revenue came to £128 992 from 290 orders. That is up +1.1% on last week and down -0.1% against the previous four weeks, so it is essentially in line with the recent run rate. Compared with the same week last year, revenue fell -6.6%. Orders rose +2.5% on the week, while average order value was £444.80, down -1.3%.

The best seller was "REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER" with £2 616, followed by "CHILLI LIGHTS" with £1 516 and "HEART OF WICKER SMALL" with £1 366. The "United Kingdom" brought in £113 110 of revenue, well ahead of "EIRE" at £6 112 and "Channel Islands" at £2 680.

We had 227 customers, made up of 42 new and 185 returning. Customer numbers were down -6.2% on last week. The cancellation rate was 22.0%, with £1 464 of product value cancelled, leaving £127 528 of revenue after cancellations.

2011-03-14.headline: Sales rose on last week and the recent average, but remain below a year ago
2011-03-14.text:
Product revenue reached £153 340 from 338 orders, up +18.9% on the previous week and up +13.1% against the four-week average. Year on year, revenue fell -6.7%. Orders increased +16.6% week on week, and average order value was £453.67, up +2.0% on last week but down -3.3% against the four-week average.

The best-selling product was "REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER" at £3 728, followed by "PARTY BUNTING" at £2 844 and "JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT" at £2 718. The "United Kingdom" brought in £129 785, with "EIRE" next at £6 338 and "Sweden" at £4 400. Nothing looked unusual this week.

We served 268 customers, of whom 49 were new and 219 were returning. Units sold were 87 407, up +26.4% on last week but down -43.9% on a year ago. The cancellation rate was 16.5%, with cancelled product value of £2 041, leaving revenue after cancellations at £151 300.

2011-03-21.headline: Sales dipped on last week but stayed ahead of the four-week average
2011-03-21.text:
Product revenue came to £144 759 from 323 orders. Revenue fell week on week (-5.6%) but was up against the four-week average (+4.3%). It was down on the same week last year (-15.7%). Orders were down week on week (-4.4%) and up on the four-week average (+7.7%). Average order value was £448.17. We had 270 customers, of whom 36 were new and 234 were returning.

The best sellers were "REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER" at £4 452, "CREAM SWEETHEART MINI CHEST" at £2 720 and "JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT" at £2 444. By country, "United Kingdom" brought in £129 210, well ahead of "Germany" at £3 395 and "France" at £2 778.

The cancellation rate was 15.2%, with cancelled product value of £1 605. Revenue after product cancellations was £143 154. Units sold were down on last year (-41.9%), so it is worth keeping an eye on how many items go into each order.

2011-03-28.headline: Revenue up strongly this week, with unusually big jumps on last week and the four-week average
2011-03-28.text:
Product revenue reached £186 551 from 355 orders, with an average order value of £525.50. Revenue was up +28.9% on last week and up +34.5% on the four-week average. Both moves are unusual, so they are worth a closer look. Against the same week last year, revenue increased +19.8%.

Orders rose +9.9% on last week, so much of the gain came from bigger baskets, with average order value up +17.3%. The best seller was "REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER" at £4 189, followed by "JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT" at £2 673. The "United Kingdom" brought in £152 242 and the "Netherlands" added £20 055.

We served 278 customers, of whom 31 were new. The cancellation rate was 16.3%, with cancelled product value of £5 367.

2011-04-04.headline: Revenue fell -34.2% on the previous week, an unusual drop
2011-04-04.text:
Product revenue came in at £122 781 from 313 orders. Revenue fell -34.2% against the previous week, which is an unusual move. It was also down -20.0% against the four-week picture and down -10.4% on last year. Orders fell -11.8% on the previous week, and the average order value of £392.27 was down -25.4%, so smaller baskets drove most of the drop.

We served 264 customers, 29 of them new and 235 returning. Customer numbers were down -5.0% on the previous week. The cancellation rate was 16.3%, with £3 744 of product value cancelled, leaving £119 037 after cancellations.

The "United Kingdom" brought in £103 244, well ahead of "EIRE" at £3 888 and "Japan" at £3 599. Among the best sellers were "PARTY BUNTING" at £2 322 and "ALARM CLOCK BAKELIKE RED" at £2 173.

2011-04-11.headline: Revenue and orders up on last week, though still below the four-week average
2011-04-11.text:
Product revenue reached £146 013 from 367 orders, up +18.9% on the previous week. Against the recent four-week average revenue was down -3.8%, and compared with the same week last year it was up +2.9%. Average order value was £397.86, up +1.4% on last week but down -13.0% against the four-week average. Nothing looked unusual this week.

We sold 87 341 units, up +28.9% on last week. There were 302 customers, made up of 36 new and 266 returning buyers. The best seller was "REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER" at £4 422, followed by "PARTY BUNTING" at £3 078 and "PAPER CHAIN KIT EMPIRE" at £2 567. The "United Kingdom" brought in £133 000, with "Germany" next at £3 837.

The cancellation rate was 14.8%, with cancelled product value of £1 875. Revenue after product cancellations came to £144 138.

2011-04-18.headline: Revenue slips and orders drop sharply, though customers spent more per order
2011-04-18.text:
Product revenue was £138 295, down -5.3% on last week. Orders came in at 267, and the drop of -27.2% on last week is an unusual move. Average order value was £517.96, up +30.2%, which cushioned the fall in revenue.

"FAIRY CAKE FLANNEL ASSORTED COLOUR" was the top product at £6 585, followed by "WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER" at £6 088. "United Kingdom" brought in £127 317, well ahead of "Germany" at £3 001.

The cancellation rate was 19.6%, with cancelled product value of £24 420. Revenue after product cancellations was £113 875. Compared with the same week a year ago, revenue is down -16.0%.

2011-04-25.headline: Revenue fell sharply this week, with a big drop in orders too
2011-04-25.text:
Product revenue was £83 375 from 212 orders, with an average order value of £393.28. Revenue was down -39.7% on the previous week, which is an unusual move. Average order value was also down, by -24.1%.

Against the average of the last four weeks, revenue fell -43.8% and orders fell -34.9%. Both are unusual moves. Compared with the same week last year, revenue was down -54.9%. We had 171 customers, of whom 14 were new. The cancellation rate was 15.5%, worth £1 944 of product value.

"REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER" led the products at £3 804, followed by "PARTY BUNTING" at £1 840. The "United Kingdom" brought in £77 998 of revenue, and "Germany" was next at £2 285.

2011-05-02.headline: Sales jumped sharply this week, with unusually big moves in revenue and orders
2011-05-02.text:
Product revenue reached £136 752 from 362 orders. Revenue rose +64.0% on the previous week, and orders rose +70.8%. Both moves are unusual, so treat them as a standout week rather than the new normal.

Against the last four weeks, revenue was up +11.5%, but it fell -14.5% compared with the same week last year. Average order value was £377.77, down -3.9% on last week. We had 289 customers, and the cancellation rate was 14.0%.

"PARTY BUNTING" led the products with £5 206, followed by "WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER" at £3 058. By country, "United Kingdom" brought in £121 120, with "EIRE" next at £6 208.

2011-05-09.headline: Revenue jumps in an unusually strong week for the shop
2011-05-09.text:
Product revenue reached £204 717 from 434 orders, with an average order value of £471.70. Revenue was up +49.7% on last week, and up +62.3% on the four-week average. Both moves are unusual. Orders were also up +43.7% on the four-week average, which is unusual too.

The best-selling product was "REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER" at £4 291, followed by "PARTY BUNTING" at £4 012. By country, "United Kingdom" brought in £157 326, then "Netherlands" with £17 195 and "Germany" with £13 823.

We served 310 customers, of whom 33 were new. The cancellation rate was 12.3%. Compared with the same week last year, revenue was up +21.7%.

2011-05-16.headline: Sales well above the recent four-week level, with an unusual jump in revenue and orders
2011-05-16.text:
Product revenue reached £210 335 from 450 orders, with an average order value of £467.41. Revenue was up +2.7% on the previous week and orders increased +3.7%, while average order value fell -0.9%.

Two moves are unusual this week. Revenue is up +49.4% and orders are up +41.2% against the recent four-week level. Compared with the same week last year, revenue is also up +42.1%, so this is a big step up and worth a closer look.

We served 347 customers, of whom 25 were new. The cancellation rate was 16.0%. "PARTY BUNTING" led the products at £3 919, followed by "SPOTTY BUNTING" at £2 795 among the top sellers. "United Kingdom" brought in £177 544, with "Australia" next at £12 691.

2011-05-23.headline: Revenue down on last week but level with the recent average
2011-05-23.text:
Product revenue came to £159 464 from 350 orders, with an average order value of £455.61. Revenue fell, down -24.2% on the week before, and orders were down -22.2%. Against the recent four-week average, revenue was up +0.4%, and compared with the same week last year it was up +3.0%. Nothing looked unusual this week.

We served 260 customers, of whom 17 were new and 243 were returning. The best sellers were "PARTY BUNTING" at £4 652, "SMALL POPCORN HOLDER" at £3 331 and "DOG BOWL CHASING BALL DESIGN" at £3 160. By country, "United Kingdom" brought in £137 821, followed by "Netherlands" at £10 373 and "Germany" at £3 228.

The cancellation rate was 21.7%, with cancelled product value of £1 804. Revenue after product cancellations was £157 660.

2011-05-30.headline: Revenue and orders both dropped sharply this week, an unusual fall
2011-05-30.text:
Product revenue came in at £115 065 from 259 orders. Revenue was down -27.8% on the previous week and down -35.3% against the recent four-week picture. Orders fell -26.0% week on week and fell -35.1% against the four-week picture. These are unusual moves and worth a closer look.

Compared with the same week last year, revenue rose +7.9%, while orders fell -6.2%. Average order value was £444.27. We had 212 customers, of whom 21 were new.

The top product was "REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER" at £3 042, followed by "PARTY BUNTING" at £2 327. By country, "United Kingdom" led with £96 177, then "Netherlands" with £6 266.

2011-06-06.headline: Revenue and orders jumped to unusually high levels, with one picnic basket leading sales
2011-06-06.text:
Product revenue reached £214 478 from 406 orders, with an average order value of £528.27. Revenue rose +86.4% on the previous week and orders rose +56.8%. Both of these moves are unusual, so they are worth a closer look before we treat them as the new normal.

One product stood out: "PICNIC BASKET WICKER SMALL" brought in £40 279, far ahead of "PARTY BUNTING" at £4 015. By country, "United Kingdom" led with £191 155, followed by "Switzerland" at £6 700 and "EIRE" at £5 398.

Compared with the average of the last four weeks, revenue was up +24.4%. Against the same week last year, revenue was up +2.0% but orders were down -11.7%. The cancellation rate was 13.6%, worth £2 548 of product value, which leaves revenue after cancellations at £211 930.

2011-06-13.headline: Revenue down on last week but still ahead of the four-week average and last year
2011-06-13.text:
Product revenue reached £186 572 from 370 orders, with an average order value of £504.25. Revenue fell -13.0% on the previous week, and orders were down -8.9%. Average order value decreased -4.5%. Units sold were up +5.7% on last week.

Against the wider picture, revenue was up +6.7% on the four-week average and up +37.2% on the same week last year. We had 286 customers, of whom 28 were new and 258 were returning. Customer numbers were down -14.1% on last week.

The best sellers were "BLACK RECORD COVER FRAME" at £2 952 and "PARTY BUNTING" at £2 933. By country, "United Kingdom" led with £136 556, followed by "Australia" at £23 427. The cancellation rate was 16.9%, and cancelled product value came to £4 301.

2011-06-20.headline: Revenue fell sharply this week, an unusual drop, as order values shrank
2011-06-20.text:
Product revenue came in at £127 369 from 334 orders, with an average order value of £381.34. Revenue fell -31.7% on the previous week, which is an unusual move. It was also down -24.6% against the four-week picture, though still up +4.2% on the same week last year. Orders were down -9.7% on last week, so the bigger drop came from smaller baskets: average order value fell -24.4%.

We had 263 customers, of whom 25 were new and 238 were returning. The cancellation rate was 20.3%, with £4 265 of product value cancelled, leaving £123 103 after cancellations. Top sellers were "PARTY BUNTING" at £2 874, "REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER" at £1 756 and "JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT" at £1 627.

By country, "United Kingdom" led with £106 328, followed by "Norway" at £5 187 and "EIRE" at £2 856.

2011-06-27.headline: Revenue edged up on last week but remains well below the recent average and last year
2011-06-27.text:
Product revenue reached £134 870 from 283 orders, with an average order value of £476.57. Revenue was up +5.9% on the previous week, but down -16.2% against the recent four-week average and down -24.3% on the same week last year.

The small gain came from bigger baskets, not more buyers. Average order value increased +25.0%, while orders fell -15.3% and customers fell -22.4%. We had 204 customers, of whom 19 were new and 185 were returning. The cancellation rate was 18.2%, which is worth keeping an eye on.

The best seller was "REGENCY TEAPOT ROSES" at £4 610, followed by "SET OF 3 REGENCY CAKE TINS" at £3 015. By country, "United Kingdom" led with £109 723, then "Netherlands" with £14 028 and "EIRE" with £7 006.

2011-07-04.headline: Revenue and orders both jumped on the week, a big unusual move
2011-07-04.text:
Product revenue reached £170 125 from 357 orders. Revenue rose +26.1% on the previous week and orders rose +26.1%, and both of these moves are unusual. Average order value was £476.54, flat at +0.0% on the week, so the jump came from more orders rather than bigger baskets.

Against the recent four-week picture the gain is much smaller: revenue was up +2.6% and orders were up +2.5%. That suggests the week was a return to a stronger level after a quieter one. We served 268 customers, of whom 16 were new. The cancellation rate was 14.0%, worth £2 247 in cancelled product value.

"PARTY BUNTING" was the top product at £4 797, followed by "PICNIC BASKET WICKER LARGE" at £2 951. "United Kingdom" brought in £152 444, well ahead of "Spain" at £4 756.

2011-07-11.headline: Revenue fell this week as orders and basket size both slipped
2011-07-11.text:
Product revenue came in at £132 563, and it fell against last week (-22.1%). It also fell against the recent four-week picture (-14.3%) and against the same week last year (-15.3%). Orders were 324, which fell week on week (-9.2%). The average order was worth £409.14, and that fell too (-14.1%), so smaller baskets explain much of the drop.

We served 261 customers, of whom 23 were new and 238 were returning. Customer numbers fell slightly week on week (-2.6%) but were up against the four-week picture (+2.3%). Top sellers were "REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER" at £3 442, "WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER" at £3 247 and "PARTY BUNTING" at £1 796. By country, "United Kingdom" led with £113 297, ahead of "Germany" at £3 762 and "Australia" at £3 698.

The cancellation rate was 14.5%, with cancelled product value of £2 012. That leaves revenue after product cancellations at £130 551. Nothing else looked unusual this week.

2011-07-18.headline: Revenue jumped sharply this week, driven by much bigger orders
2011-07-18.text:
Product revenue reached £187 781 from 355 orders. Revenue was up +41.7% on the previous week and up +33.0% on the four-week comparison. Both moves are unusual, so they are worth a closer look before we treat them as the new normal.

Order numbers grew far more gently, up +9.6% on last week. The real lift came from bigger baskets: average order value was £528.96, up +29.3%. Units sold were 109 686. We served 281 customers, of whom 27 were new.

The top sellers were "PARTY BUNTING" with £5 010 and "REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER" with £4 069. By country, "United Kingdom" brought in £155 205 and "EIRE" added £15 850. The cancellation rate was 19.9%, so it is worth keeping an eye on how much of this revenue sticks.

2011-07-25.headline: Revenue down -4.8% on last week but up +14.3% on the four-week average
2011-07-25.text:
Product revenue reached £178 713 from 343 orders, with an average order value of £521.03. Revenue fell -4.8% on the previous week, but it was up +14.3% on the recent four-week average and up +15.2% on the same week last year. Orders were down -3.4% on last week and down -0.3% on last year, so the yearly gain came from bigger baskets, with average order value up +15.6%.

We served 277 customers, of whom 27 were new and 250 were returning. The best sellers were "REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER" at £3 893, "REGENCY TEAPOT ROSES" at £3 425 and "CHILLI LIGHTS" at £3 121. The "United Kingdom" brought in £139 689, followed by "EIRE" at £21 616 and "Sweden" at £3 867.

The cancellation rate was 14.0%, with cancelled product value of £1 620, leaving revenue after product cancellations at £177 092. Nothing looked unusual this week.

2011-08-01.headline: Revenue of £167 894 fell on last week but is level with the recent average
2011-08-01.text:
Product revenue reached £167 894 from 314 orders. Revenue fell, with a week-on-week change of -6.1%, but it was up +0.4% on the four-week average and up +33.7% on the same week last year. Orders were down -8.5% on last week and down -8.9% on the four-week average, while up +0.3% on last year. Average order value was £534.70, up +2.6% on last week.

We served 274 customers, of whom 30 were new and 244 were returning. Customer numbers were down -1.1% on last week and up +0.8% on the four-week average. The top sellers were "ASSORTED COLOUR BIRD ORNAMENT" at £5 616, "IVORY DINER WALL CLOCK" at £2 730 and "PARTY BUNTING" at £2 468.

The "United Kingdom" brought in £146 045, well ahead of "EIRE" at £5 908 and "Germany" at £4 524. The cancellation rate was 14.2%, with cancelled product value of £6 153, leaving revenue after cancellations at £161 741.

2011-08-08.headline: Revenue edged up this week, but orders and customers fell and cancellations were high
2011-08-08.text:
Product revenue reached £169 283 from 270 orders, up +0.8% on the week before. Orders fell -14.0% and customers were down -18.2% to 224, of whom 12 were new and 212 were returning. Average order value was £626.97, up +17.3%, which is why revenue held steady on fewer orders.

Against the recent four-week picture, revenue was up +1.5% but orders were down -19.2%. Compared with the same week last year, revenue fell -2.4% and units sold decreased -46.0%. The cancellation rate was 21.1%, with cancelled product value of £1 517, leaving revenue after product cancellations at £167 766.

The top product was "JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT" at £2 816, followed by "JUMBO BAG VINTAGE DOILY" at £2 457. By country, "United Kingdom" led with £124 341, then "Netherlands" with £32 475 and "EIRE" with £5 871.

2011-08-15.headline: Revenue of £173 146 is up on last week, with more orders but smaller baskets
2011-08-15.text:
Product revenue reached £173 146 from 315 orders, with an average order value of £549.67. Revenue rose +2.3% on last week, was down -1.6% against the recent four-week picture, and up +3.8% on the same week last year. Nothing looked unusual this week.

Orders increased +16.7% on last week, but the average order value fell -12.3%, so customers bought more often and spent less each time. We served 275 customers, of whom 33 were new and 242 were returning. The cancellation rate was 13.7%, with cancelled product value of £3 252, leaving £169 893 after cancellations.

The top sellers were "JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT" at £2 581, "SPOTTY BUNTING" at £2 552 and "REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER" at £2 545. By country, "United Kingdom" led with £130 988, followed by "Australia" at £21 880 and "Israel" at £4 874.

2011-08-22.headline: Revenue slipped this week even though orders grew
2011-08-22.text:
Product revenue came in at £160 922, which fell, shown as -7.1% on the previous week and down -6.6% against the recent four-week picture. Compared with the same week last year, revenue was up +11.4%. Orders increased to 356, up +13.0% on the week, but the average order value of £452.03 was down -17.8%, so each order was worth less.

We served 301 customers, of whom 25 were new, and customers were up +9.5% on the week. The cancellation rate was 14.2%. Cancelled product value was £3 078, which leaves revenue after product cancellations at £157 844.

Top sellers were "REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER" at £2 895, "JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT" at £2 768 and "PARTY BUNTING" at £2 730. By country, "United Kingdom" led with £132 341, followed by "Netherlands" at £7 853 and "Germany" at £4 969.

2011-08-29.headline: Revenue slipped week on week but stayed ahead of the same week last year
2011-08-29.text:
Product revenue came to £146 554 from 282 orders, with an average order value of £519.69. Revenue fell -8.9% on the previous week. Against the recent four-week average, revenue was down -12.7%. Compared with the same week a year ago, revenue was up +4.8%.

Orders fell -20.8% on the previous week. Average order value rose +15.0% over the same period, so fewer but larger orders held revenue up. We served 225 customers, of whom 23 were new. Customer numbers fell -25.2% week on week.

The best sellers were "RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT" at £2 155 and "WOOD BLACK BOARD ANT WHITE FINISH" at £2 057. "United Kingdom" brought in £122 920, followed by "Germany" at £8 397. The cancellation rate was 19.0%, with cancelled product value of £9 336.

2011-09-05.headline: Sales jumped this week, with unusually big rises in revenue and orders
2011-09-05.text:
Product revenue reached £187 162 from 391 orders. Revenue was up +27.7% on the week before, which is an unusual move. Orders were up +38.7% on last week and up +27.9% against the four-week picture, and both of those moves are also unusual. Average order value fell -7.9%, so the growth came from more orders rather than bigger baskets.

The best sellers were "PLEASE ONE PERSON METAL SIGN" at £2 773, "PARTY BUNTING" at £1 825 and "REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER" at £1 825. By country, "United Kingdom" brought in £150 585, then "EIRE" with £17 934 and "France" with £7 101.

We served 313 customers, of whom 26 were new and 287 were returning. The cancellation rate was 11.7%, with cancelled product value of £1 869, which leaves revenue after product cancellations at £185 294.

2011-09-12.headline: Revenue well ahead of the recent average, an unusual jump, though orders were down on last week
2011-09-12.text:
Product revenue reached £223 864 from 360 orders. Revenue was up +19.6% on last week and up +34.1% against the four-week average, which is an unusual move. It was also up +37.6% on the same week last year. Orders were down -7.9% on last week, so the gain came from bigger baskets: average order value was £621.84, up +29.9% on last week.

We served 301 customers, of whom 41 were new and 260 were returning. The best-selling products were "DOORMAT PEACE ON EARTH BLUE" at £2 943 and "DOORMAT UNION FLAG" at £2 703. The "United Kingdom" brought in £203 298, well ahead of "Netherlands" at £8 281.

The cancellation rate was 19.5%, with cancelled product value of £1 594. Revenue after product cancellations was £222 270.

2011-09-19.headline: Revenue and orders jump to an unusually strong week, led by pantry products
2011-09-19.text:
Product revenue reached £328 713 from 463 orders. Revenue was up +46.8% on the week before and up +83.0% against the recent four-week picture, and both moves are unusual. Orders also increased, up +28.6% on last week and up +33.3% against the four-week picture, which is unusual too.

Pantry items led the product list. "SET OF TEA COFFEE SUGAR TINS PANTRY" brought in £8 631, followed by "PANTRY CHOPPING BOARD" at £4 898. By country, "United Kingdom" was far ahead with £270 989, then "Netherlands" with £16 433.

Average order value came to £709.96, and we served 383 customers, of whom 64 were new. The cancellation rate was 17.0%, so it is worth keeping an eye on as volumes grow.

2011-09-26.headline: Revenue fell sharply this week, an unusual drop driven by smaller orders
2011-09-26.text:
Product revenue was £206 504 from 441 orders. Revenue was down -37.2% on the previous week, which is an unusual move. Compared with the same week last year it was down -32.6%. The average order value was £468.26, which fell -34.0% on the week, so the drop came mostly from smaller baskets. Order numbers held up better: orders were down -4.8% on the week but up +17.9% against the recent four-week average. Units sold came to 120 094.

The top sellers were "DOORMAT KEEP CALM AND COME IN" at £4 515 and "CHRISTMAS LIGHTS 10 REINDEER" at £2 726. The "United Kingdom" brought in £184 747 and "EIRE" followed with £10 288. We served 374 customers, of whom 45 were new.

The cancellation rate was 15.2%, with cancelled product value of £4 152. Revenue after those cancellations was £202 352.

2011-10-03.headline: Revenue up sharply to £310 948, an unusual jump, but cancellations were high
2011-10-03.text:
Product revenue reached £310 948 from 488 orders. Revenue rose +50.6% on last week and +31.4% against the four-week average. Both moves are unusual, so they are worth a closer look before we count on them continuing.

Much of the lift came from bigger baskets. Average order value was £637.19, up +36.1% on last week, while orders rose +10.7%. The cancellation rate was 17.7%, with £10 641 of product value cancelled, which leaves £300 307 of revenue after cancellations.

The top seller was "DOORMAT KEEP CALM AND COME IN" at £6 106, followed by "JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT" at £5 007. "United Kingdom" brought in £269 442, with "Australia" at £17 151 and "Germany" at £9 904. We served 389 customers, of whom 67 were new.

2011-10-10.headline: Revenue fell sharply this week, an unusual drop on last week
2011-10-10.text:
Product revenue came in at £221 268, and the week-on-week change of -28.8% means revenue fell by an unusual amount. Orders numbered 448, and the week-on-week change in orders was -8.2%, so orders were down much less than revenue. Average order value was £493.90, and its week-on-week change was -22.5%, so each order was worth noticeably less.

We served 360 customers, of whom 49 were new. Customer numbers were down, with a week-on-week change of -7.5%. Cancellations were worth £17 017, and the cancellation rate was 15.3%.

The "United Kingdom" brought in £181 061, well ahead of "EIRE" at £7 181 and "France" at £6 678. Among products, "FELTCRAFT DOLL MOLLY" made £2 286, "DOORMAT KEEP CALM AND COME IN" made £2 069 and "JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT" made £1 887.

2011-10-17.headline: Revenue rose +19.5% on last week, driven by bigger orders rather than more of them
2011-10-17.text:
Product revenue reached £264 355 from 446 orders. Revenue rose +19.5% on the previous week, even though orders were slightly down at -0.4%. The gain came from larger baskets: average order value was £592.72, up +20.0%, and units sold were 152 266, up +29.5%.

Against the last four weeks, revenue was down -0.9%, so this week is roughly in line with the recent run. Compared with the same week last year, revenue rose +9.7% but orders fell -18.6%. We served 364 customers, of whom 47 were new and 317 were returning.

"United Kingdom" led the countries with £195 804, followed by "Netherlands" at £29 458. The top product was "LANDMARK FRAME COVENT GARDEN" at £3 766. The cancellation rate was 13.9%, with cancelled product value of £5 304, leaving revenue after cancellations at £259 051.

2011-10-24.headline: Revenue dipped on the week even though more orders came in
2011-10-24.text:
Product revenue came to £242 683 from 519 orders, with an average order value of £467.60. Revenue fell -8.2% on the previous week and was down -3.2% against the recent four-week picture, but it is up +14.3% on the same week last year. Orders rose +16.4% week on week, while average order value fell -21.1%, so customers bought more often but spent less each time. We served 419 customers, of whom 49 were new and 370 were returning.

"RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT" led the products at £10 739, well ahead of "ALARM CLOCK BAKELIKE RED" at £2 423 and "CHILLI LIGHTS" at £2 285. By country, "United Kingdom" brought in £205 033, followed by "Netherlands" at £9 995 and "France" at £9 730.

The cancellation rate was 15.6%, with cancelled product value of £8 480. Revenue after product cancellations was £234 203. Nothing else looked unusual this week.

2011-10-31.headline: Revenue up on last week and ahead of the recent average, with no unusual moves
2011-10-31.text:
Product revenue reached £292 748 from 527 orders. Revenue was up +20.6% on last week and up +12.7% on the average of the last four weeks. Against the same week last year it increased +3.8%. Average order value was £555.50, up +18.8% on last week, so bigger baskets drove much of the gain.

We served 441 customers, of whom 50 were new and 391 were returning. Customer numbers were up +5.3% on last week. Units sold came to 158 183, up +6.1% on last week but down -2.9% on last year. The cancellation rate was 14.7%.

The top sellers were "WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER" at £5 241, "RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT" at £5 235 and "PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS" at £5 019. The "United Kingdom" brought in £260 600, with "Switzerland" next at £6 208.

2011-11-07.headline: Sales jumped this week, with unusually big moves against the recent four-week average
2011-11-07.text:
Product revenue reached £357 707 from 634 orders, with an average order value of £564.21. Revenue was up +22.2% on last week, and orders were up +20.3%. Against the last four weeks, revenue was up +40.1% and orders were up +30.7%. Both of those moves are unusual. Compared with the same week last year, revenue fell -3.0% and orders fell -3.5%.

The best sellers were "RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT" at £7 474, "PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS" at £6 303 and "POPCORN HOLDER" at £5 395. The "United Kingdom" brought in £323 815, well ahead of "Netherlands" at £9 793 and "EIRE" at £9 673.

We served 514 customers, of whom 46 were new. The cancellation rate was 14.6%, with cancelled product value of £7 583, leaving revenue after cancellations at £350 123.

2011-11-14.headline: Revenue up on last week, with an unusual jump against the four-week average
2011-11-14.text:
Product revenue reached £373 175 from 687 orders, with an average order value of £543.20. Revenue was up +4.3% on last week and up +7.8% on the same week last year. Two moves against the four-week average were unusual: revenue rose +29.0% and orders rose +29.3%.

"RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT" led the products with £10 684, followed by "PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS" at £9 462. "United Kingdom" brought in £320 779, well ahead of "EIRE" at £10 506 and "Germany" at £9 192.

The average order value fell -3.7% on last week, so the growth came from more orders rather than bigger baskets. There were 569 customers, of whom 43 were new. The cancellation rate was 15.0%, with cancelled product value of £4 049, leaving revenue of £369 126 after cancellations.

2011-11-21.headline: Sales slipped this week, with revenue lower than the week before
2011-11-21.text:
Product revenue reached £302 392 from 616 orders, with an average order value of £490.90. Against the week before, revenue fell, with a change of -19.0%. Compared with the recent four-week pace it was down, at -4.5%, while against the same time last year it was up, at +2.1%.

Orders also fell on the week before, at -10.3%. We served 492 customers, of whom 37 were new and 455 were returning. The cancellation rate was 10.2%, with cancelled product value of £7 159, which leaves revenue after product cancellations at £295 233.

Top sellers were "PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS" at £5 698, "RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT" at £5 104 and "CHILLI LIGHTS" at £4 960. By country, "United Kingdom" led with £265 610, followed by "Netherlands" at £10 798 and "Germany" at £6 260. Nothing looked unusual this week.

2011-11-28.headline: Revenue edges up on the week but stays below the recent four-week level
2011-11-28.text:
Product revenue reached £309 378 from 663 orders. Revenue was up +2.3% on the previous week, but down -6.7% against the four-week comparison and down -2.5% on the same week last year. Orders increased +7.6% on the week, while average order value was £466.63, down -4.9%, so more orders came in but each was smaller.

The shop served 514 customers, of whom 31 were new and 483 were returning. The cancellation rate was 15.2%. Customer numbers were up +4.5% on the week.

The top seller was "RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT" with £9 249, followed by "PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS" at £4 607. "United Kingdom" brought in £279 904 of revenue, well ahead of "France" with £8 059.

2011-12-05.headline: Partial week with large cancellations: treat the revenue jump with caution
2011-12-05.text:
This was a partial week, with data stopping before the week ended, and cancellations were large. Product revenue was £483 725, but £172 782 of product value was cancelled, which leaves £310 943 after cancellations. The cancellation rate was 14.3%, so the headline revenue is not a clean win.

Revenue made an unusual move: it rose +56.4% on last week and rose +44.1% against the four-week average. Orders told a different story, with orders down -23.2% on last week, at 509 in total. Average order value was £950.34. One product, "PAPER CRAFT , LITTLE BIRDIE", brought in £168 470, so the jump leans heavily on a single item.

Most sales came from "United Kingdom" at £450 021, followed by "Netherlands" at £11 728. There were 415 customers, of whom 17 were new.
